discovery.capacity: 34,820 (Wikipedia, current/2025 official figure). CONFLICTING SECONDARY FIGURES: 34,631 (itinerantfan.com), '~35,000' (ballparksofbaseball.com). Smallest capacity in MLB. Original 1994 capacity was 42,865-43,000+; ~2015 renovations removed roughly 7,000 seats, and the 2023-2025 renovation held capacity near 35,000.

orientation.batter_faces: UNCERTAIN - most likely NORTHEAST. Home plate sits at the southwest corner of the block, at the Carnegie Avenue / Ontario Street intersection ('Carnegie Avenue and Ontario Street intersect in front of Progressive Field's home plate gate'), with the outfield opening away from the downtown core to the northeast. Corroborated by the official accessibility guide's elevator landmarks: the section 159 elevator is the 'Ontario' elevator (west side) and the section 149 elevator is the 'Carnegie' elevator (south side) - i.e. home plate sections 152-155 sit in the SW corner between them - while the section 117 elevator is 'East 9th Street' (east side), placing right-field sections 101-117 on the east flank.
orientation.conflicting_claim: theshadium.com states the ballpark is oriented at 356 degrees, i.e. 'center field points toward the north and home plate faces due south' - that source's own wording is internally inconsistent (356 deg = home-plate-to-center-field bearing = essentially due north, which would mean the batter faces north, not south). Treat the exact bearing as unresolved; north-to-northeast is the defensible range. Source: https://theshadium.com/blog/shaded-seats-progressive-field
orientation.shade_implication_confirmed: Third base side gets shade earlier / has better afternoon sun protection; first base side and outfield trend sunnier. Stated by both theshadium.com and RateYourSeats upper-level section pages.

numbering_direction.summary: CONFIRMED - section numbers INCREASE toward THIRD BASE and LEFT FIELD. The sequence runs: right-center/right field (lowest numbers) -> right field corner -> first base side -> behind home plate -> third base side -> left field bleachers (highest numbers). This holds on every level: 100 level runs 101 (right field) to 185 (left field bleachers); 400 level runs 403 (right field side) to 478 (left field side); 500 level runs 519 to 567. NOTE: this is the opposite of the claim made by thestadiuminsiders.com, which asserted numbers increase toward first base/right field - that source is contradicted by every primary section page and by the official Guardians accessibility guide, and should be disregarded.

renovation_current_configuration.summary: CONFIRMED. A $200M+ renovation (Guardians $67M / public $130M) was agreed in 2022, with construction running after the 2023 season through the 2025 season (some reporting extends the program to 2026). Progressive Field is in its post-renovation configuration for 2025-2026, which is why several section-number ranges are gapped or missing versus older seating charts.
changes: RIGHT-FIELD UPPER DECK: the shipping-container structures installed in 2014 (each bearing a franchise legend's name and number) were demolished and replaced with an open-air concourse with expanded food and beverage. This explains the sparse/gapped 500-level numbering at the low end (519-541).

LEFT-FIELD UPPER DECK: several seating sections were REMOVED and replaced with a common gathering area of picnic tables and drink rails, plus canopied 'destination decks'. This explains the gapped 500-level numbering at the high end (546-567) and the presence of the 'Upper Outfield Terrace' and 'The Corner Drink Rails' as non-numbered inventory.
OPEN CONCOURSE added in the upper deck; expanded left-field seating; modifications to the right-field upper deck.

BEHIND HOME PLATE: upgraded seating - sections 152-155 now have movable chairs with a food/drink/phone ledge. Six new dugout suites seating 12 each were added behind home plate (sold on RateYourSeats as 'Dugout Lounge 1-6').
NORTH COAST SOCIAL CLUB: reopened area along the left-field line, formerly the Terrace Club, with semi-private boxes for smaller groups.
SEAT COLOR: all original green seats being replaced with blue; over 80% of the lower bowl was blue by Opening Day 2025, with the remainder swapped during the season.
Remodeled clubhouses and a new service building in the right-field plaza. Capacity held at roughly 34,800-35,000.

accessibility.summary: CONFIRMED from the official Guardians Access Guide. Wheelchair spaces are distributed across every seating tier with companion seating adjacent: 'Wheelchair spaces are available throughout the ballpark' with a 'combination of companion seating adjacent.' Manual wheelchairs are provided on a first-come, first-served basis at ALL gates for transport to a seat. The Fan Service Center in section 153 (directly behind home plate) checks out assistive listening devices and noise-cancelling headphones. Accessible family restrooms are on the Family Deck.
landmarks: Elevator at section 159 - the 'Ontario' elevator (Ontario Street / west side, third base side of home plate) - serves suites and upper levels
Elevator at section 149 - the 'Carnegie' elevator (Carnegie Avenue / south side, first base side of home plate) - serves suites and club seating
Elevator at section 117 - the 'East 9th Street' elevator (east side, right field) - serves the Family Deck and suites, 4th level only
Fan Service Center in section 153 - assistive listening devices and noise-cancelling headphones
Wheelchair escort service available at all gates (Left Field Gate, Right Field Gate, Ontario Street entrance, Media Gate)
Accessible family restrooms on the Family Deck
Ontario Street entrance is the bus drop-off / pick-up zone

discovery.row_seat_conventions: ROWS ARE LETTERS, not numbers - CONFIRMED on every section page checked, with no numeric-row section found. Rows run A-Z and then continue with doubled letters AA, BB, CC ... HH. Examples verbatim: 'Rows in Section 101 are labeled A-C'; 'Rows in Section 108 are labeled A-Z, AA-CC'; 'Rows in Section 113 are labeled A-Z, AA-CC'; 'Rows in Section 149 are labeled F-Z, AA-HH'; 'Rows in Section 153 are labeled L-Z, AA-EE, FF-HH'; 'Rows in Section 160 are labeled F-Z, AA-HH'; 'Rows in Section 177 are labeled Y-Z, AA-HH'; 'Rows in Section 183 are labeled A-Y'; 'Rows in Section 330 are labeled A-T'; 'Rows in Section 334 are labeled A-T'; 'Rows in Section 338 are labeled A-T'; 'Rows in Section 425 are labeled A-F'; 'Rows in Section 444 are labeled A-F'; 'Rows in Section 448 are labeled A-F'; 'Rows in Section 451 are labeled A-F'; 'Rows in Section 452 are labeled A-F'; 'Rows in Section 546 are labeled A-X'; 'Rows in Section 551 are labeled A-X'; 'Rows in Section 553 are labeled A-X'. Important: infield lower-bowl sections do NOT start at row A - they start mid-alphabet (F, L, or Y) because the rows in front belong to the premium Field Seats/Diamond Box product. Row letters ascend AWAY from the field (row A is closest to the field where present; the section entrance is at the highest row letter, e.g. 'An entrance to this section is located at Row F' for 400-level sections and 'at Row HH' for section 177). Level row depths: 400 level A-F (shallow), Press Level club A-T, 500 level A-X, lower bowl through HH. SEAT NUMBERS are numeric and ascend right-to-left as you face the field.
discovery.seat1_side_verbatim: "When looking towards the field, lower number seats are on the right" - quoted verbatim and identically from the RateYourSeats section pages for 149, 153, 160, 177, 183, 108, 113, 334, 425, 444, 448, 451, 452, 546, 551 and 553. CONFIRMED as a venue-wide rule with zero counterexamples found. Practical restatement: SEAT 1 IS ON THE RIGHT-HAND SIDE WHEN FACING THE FIELD, so seat numbers increase from right to left as the fan looks toward the diamond. Corroborating verbatim example from section 101: "Seat 1 in 101 will have you right on the rail" and "Seats #1 in this section are directly next to the bullpen" - the bullpen is on the right-hand edge of 101 when facing the field.
discovery.known_obstructions: 1) SECTION 180-185 (left field bleachers): the main videoboard is DIRECTLY BEHIND these sections - fans must turn around to see it, so the primary scoreboard is effectively unusable from the left field bleachers. Verbatim: 'The main videoboard is directly behind the section and requires turning around to view.' 2) BLEACHER COMFORT: sections 180-185 are bench-style with back support but NO individual armrests. 3) COVERED/OVERHANG ROWS - the deck above cuts off the sky and can block high fly balls and the videoboard: Press Level club 'Rows M & Above - Covered' (sections 326-348); 500 Level 'Rows P & Above - Covered'. 4) UPPER-LEVEL STEEPNESS: RateYourSeats experts call the Upper Level Infield 'unreasonably steep' and recommend the 400 level over the 500 level to minimize stairs - a mobility concern rather than a sightline one. 5) DISTANCE: sections 177-179 have decent sight lines for down-the-line seats but are 'the furthest away from home plate' of the field-level sections. 6) CONCESSION SCARCITY on 400/500: 'concessions are few and far between on these levels.' 7) SUN EXPOSURE: first base side and outfield trend sunnier through the afternoon; third base side shades first. UNCERTAIN: no source consulted enumerated specific pole/railing/handrail obstructed-view seat numbers, and the Guardians do not publish an obstructed-view section list.
uncertain: COMPASS ORIENTATION is the weakest field. theshadium.com claims 356 degrees ('center field points toward the north') but its own prose then says 'home plate faces due south', which is self-contradictory. Street geometry from the official accessibility guide (Ontario elevator at 159, Carnegie elevator at 149, East 9th elevator at 117) plus the home-plate gate at the Carnegie/Ontario intersection points to home plate in the SW corner and the batter facing NORTHEAST. baseball-almanac.com, ballparks.com and tht.fangraphs.com all present orientation only as un-scrapable diagrams. Range to treat as safe: batter faces somewhere between due north and northeast.

TOTAL CAPACITY varies by source: 34,820 (Wikipedia, preferred), 34,631 (itinerantfan.com), ~35,000 (ballparksofbaseball.com). Differences likely reflect whether standing room and renovation-era changes are counted.

300 / PRESS LEVEL BEHIND-HOME-PLATE ANCHOR is unresolved. The club block 326-348 is described as 'primarily along the first base side'; sections 330, 332, 334 and 338 all read as first base side, and no page confirms a numbered 300 section directly behind the plate. Estimate 340-344 if forced.
CONCERT CONFIGURATION: no concert-only section list is published by RateYourSeats or any other source checked for Progressive Field. concert_only_sections is returned empty rather than guessed.
VICTORY CLUB SECTION LABELS 'PC1-PC6' come only from thestadiuminsiders.com, a source that was demonstrably wrong on dugout sides and numbering direction. Do not rely on those labels.

DUGOUT SUITE LABELS: RateYourSeats sells 'Dugout Lounge 1-6' and thestadiuminsiders.com references 'Dugout Suites D1-D10'. The counts conflict (6 vs 10); the renovation reporting supports six new 12-person dugout suites behind home plate.

thestadiuminsiders.com should be treated as UNRELIABLE for this venue overall: it inverted the dugout sides, inverted the section numbering direction, and mislabeled sections 103-113 as 'left-center and right field'. Every one of those claims is contradicted by primary section pages and the official Guardians accessibility guide.

mlb.com/guardians/ballpark/seating-map renders its seating map via JavaScript and returned no extractable section data; the official numbered map could not be scraped. All level/section-range mappings therefore rest on RateYourSeats plus the official accessibility guide's section lists, which agree with each other.

MINI-MONSTER 'WALL SEATS': Progressive Field's 19-foot left field wall has NO seats mounted on top of it (unlike Fenway). The nearest equivalent is bleacher sections 180-185 sitting above and behind the wall. If the caller expected a Fenway-style Green Monster seat product, it does not exist here.
The exact side (left vs right field) of the 'Upper Outfield Terrace' ticketed area is not stated by RateYourSeats; renovation reporting points to the LEFT field upper deck, but this is inference.
